description: Use when you need one US stock's latest risk numbers: hedge ratios to SPY and to its sector and subsector ETFs, explained-risk shares by layer, volatility, closing price and market cap. Not for a layer-by-layer decomposition or the ETF hedge of a dollar position (use riskmodels_decompose), several stocks at once (use riskmodels_compare) or daily history (use riskmodels_get_returns). Returns the latest row of GET /metrics/{ticker}, including the hedge_levels block with hedge ratios, explained risk and hedge ETFs at L1, L2 and L3. End-of-day data, refreshed after each US market close. Price: $0.005 per call.

ticker.description: US stock ticker symbol, case-insensitive, e.g. NVDA

name: riskmodels_get_stock_snapshot
title: RiskModels Stock Risk Snapshot
